title: Trace schema v0.1
description: The simulator's output: the level of every signal over time. A signal is a net id ("c1") or an element output ("fa0.S"). Every signal starts at "X" before time 0. `changes` lists every change of level with its time, in time order; `steps` gives each scenario step's interval and the level of every signal at the end of it. Levels are the strings "0", "1", "X" and "Z". Structure only: that the steps are contiguous and that `changes` replays to the step values is a separate semantic check (see validate/).

schema.description: Format and version. Readers reject an unknown major version.

circuit.description: Path of the circuit file that was simulated, relative to the repository root.

scenario.description: Id of the scenario that drove the simulation.

signals.description: Every net and every element output that was simulated, in display order.

end.description: Total time simulated: the end of the last step.

changes.description: Every change of level, from the all-X start, sorted by time. With zero delay all of a step's changes happen at its start time.

warnings.description: Problems met while simulating, such as a combinational loop. A signal in a loop is reported and left at X; the simulator never hangs.

signal.description: A net id, or "element.pin" for an element output.

index.description: Position of the matching step in the scenario.

values.description: Level of every signal at the end of the step (after everything has settled or the step's time has run out).
